page.layout: One page of a table, one block. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Below it a column header in two lines across the full width, then 38 table rows (year before Christ, Aureus number, Olympiad year, Urbis conditae year, dominical letters, Nabonassar year, feast days). A single "X" centred at the foot.

main_text.l: Anni ante | Aur. | Anni O- | Anni Vrb. | Literae Nabona- | Feriae.
ord. Iul. | num. | lymp. | conditae | domin. [?]sari. |

page.notes: The third header line reads "domin. fari." or "domin. sari."; the first letter is unclear, probably "s" as in Nabonassari, so marked [?]. Dashes after the Nabonassar year are printed leader lines, not text. The "10" and "9" in rows 190 and 171 stand at the left of the column of Aureus numbers and are copied as printed. The column of feast days is partly unreadable at the leaders and is copied as far as it is legible. The "X" at the foot is taken as a gathering signature.
